sql.query: UPDATE tbl_generated_contracts gc SET gc.status='draft',gc.pdfStoragePath=NULL,gc.pdfFileName=NULL,gc.pdfSha256=NULL,gc.pdfGeneratedDate=NULL,gc.issuedDate=NULL,gc.issuedByUserId=NULL,gc.draftModifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,gc.draftModifiedByUserId=:userId,gc.modifiedByUserId=:userId2,gc.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE gc.id=:contractId AND gc.tenantId=:tenantId AND gc.status IN ('issued','sent') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_contract_versions cv WHERE cv.contractId=gc.id AND cv.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND cv.contractVersionNumber=gc.contractVersionNumber) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_roles r ON r.id=utr.roleId AND r.isActive=1 INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=r.id INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.permissionCode='agreements.revise' AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:roleUser AND utr.tenantId=gc.tenantId AND utr.isActive=1)
